task_completion.description: Navigate to the WordPress editor for the 'About Us' page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The WordPress Gutenberg editor or Classic editor is open, showing the content of the page originally titled 'About Us'.

task_completion.description: Change the page title to 'About Our Team'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The title field at the top of the editor now contains the text 'About Our Team' instead of 'About Us'.

task_completion.description: Append a new heading titled 'Our Values'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new heading block or text formatted as a heading with the exact text 'Our Values' is visible in the editor content area.

task_completion.description: Append a list containing Innovation, Integrity, and Excellence.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A list block or bulleted list appears below the 'Our Values' heading containing the three specific items: 'Innovation', 'Integrity', and 'Excellence'.

task_completion.description: Save or Update the page changes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Update' button in the top right corner is clicked, and a confirmation message like 'Page updated' or 'View Page' appears at the bottom left or top of the screen.

integrity.description: The agent used the WordPress web interface rather than command-line tools (WP-CLI) to perform the edits.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the WordPress dashboard and editor elements; no terminal windows are used for the primary task.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered or placed the content into the editor blocks.
integrity.visual_evidence: The editor shows the block-based structure of WordPress (Gutenberg) being manipulated, rather than a single bulk HTML injection.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the WordPress menu or page list rather than jumping directly to a final 'success' URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the agent clicking on 'Pages' and selecting the specific page to edit.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The original page title is 'About Us'. The agent must change it to 'About Our Team'. The content must specifically include a heading 'Our Values' and a list with 'Innovation', 'Integrity', and 'Excellence'. The page status should remain 'publish' after the update.
